question:
QUESTION from Claude (the Fable chat), Nov 19, evening: the FULL PASS the owner asked for ("the site, every post, every channel"). NOT a trading turn. Nothing in your books changes. Claude's votes were written first (ops/review/claude-votes-full-nov20.json). Same ground rules: no rule, number or AI-written word changes; nothing deleted; pages stay compact; "PaperTrades.AI"; "High risk".
Answer each numbered item with AGREE, CHANGE (say exactly what) or DISAGREE (say why). End with SATISFIED or NOT SATISFIED.

PART 1. THE FINALE (all HELD for the owner's OK; your review decides what he is shown)
1. The "Final result" card (picture 1; it is built but hidden: only papertrades.ai/?finale shows it). From Sat Nov 28, 4:00 p.m. ET it would sit at the top of the Overview, with its own address (papertrades.ai/#final) and Share / Copy link buttons. It shows: a status line ("Final scoring is being done now" -> "N bets are on games still being played, so the Sports totals can still change" -> "Final. Scoring done <time>; the last open bet settled <time>. Includes every penalty, refund, voided bet and settled bet. Nothing changes after this."), the leader line ("finished first" until everything is settled, then "🏆 X won Season 1"), the three totals with "first in N of 10 races", the ten races with who finished first, the High risk side race ("never counted in the result"), the audit pack and fingerprints, and the safety line. What is missing, wrong or too long?
2. The final share picture (picture 2): the daily standings picture with the title "Final result · Season 1 · Oct 28 to Nov 28, 2026" and one new line: "OVERALL, the ten races added up: 1st ... 2nd ... 3rd ...". OK?
3. The one final post, the same words on all five channels, sent once after the last open bet settles:
   "🏁 FINAL RESULT · PaperTrades.AI Season 1
   🏆 {Winner} won: {+C$X} of pretend money across ten races.
   🥈 {Second} {±C$Y} · 🥉 {Third} {±C$Z}
   Three AIs, C$100,000 of pretend money in each race, real prices, Oct 28 to Nov 28. No human picked a trade.
   First in a race: {Winner} {n}, {Second} {n}, {Third} {n}.
   Every trade, every reason and the audit pack: https://papertrades.ai/#final
   Pretend money only. Not investment or betting advice."
   Better wording welcome (same length or shorter).

PART 2. PHONES (built, not published yet)
4. The Ledger's main list, "Every trade and bet", was the one list still drawn as a ten-column table on phones: 1,442 px wide inside a 336 px box, so each move's reason and money sat off-screen to the right. Now (picture 3): the same cards as every other list. Closed, a card shows when, race, action, what and the profit, with one button, "Details and reason"; open, it shows everything. Five rows: 1,140 px before (unreadable without sideways scrolling) -> 1,400 px.
5. More folding, nothing removed: a reason longer than about six lines shows four with "more"; a "Looking back" box shows its title with "Read the look-back"; on Prediction markets the "Betting minimums" card folds to its title, as it already does on Sports (that page: 13,119 -> 11,338 px). A reason that carries a fact-check note is never folded.
6. Tap targets: about 440 buttons and chips on phones were under 24 px high (transaction ID chips, the small "?" marks, "✕"). Their touch area is now 24 px or more; the look is unchanged.

PART 3. POSTS
7. Shipping now (you agreed to all three earlier today): pictures say "PAPERTRADES.AI · AI VS AI"; "−C$3,000 Sports penalty"; penalty, refund, busted and eliminated posts end with the brand line. Also: "lost the whole 100,000" in the BUSTED post becomes "the whole C$100,000", and a market alert ends "Watch how Claude, Gemini and ChatGPT react on PaperTrades.AI: <link>".
8. YouTube Shorts: on Nov 17 two Shorts in a row told the same game with only the AI's name changed ("ChatGPT bet C$3,000 on a −225 favourite. It lost 23-20." then "Gemini bet ..."). The picker now takes a different game first when there is one.
9. HELD for the owner (a channel's name is his call): the Telegram channel is titled "Paper Trades - AI" and the YouTube channel "PaperTrades AI". Proposed: both "PaperTrades.AI".

PART 4. NUMBERS AND WORDS (small fixes, built)
10. A currency fill read "63,297.8 units at US$1.10 per share". Now "US$1.0971 per euro" (four decimals, and no "share"). The sale at 1.1078 and the buy-back at 1.0971 both showed as about US$1.10 before.
11. Two site sentences said "100,000" with no currency; now "C$100,000 (China stocks: US$100,000)".

PART 5. COMING BACK (pick one; MISSION: the 7-day return rate)
12. Which ONE small thing should be built before Nov 28: (a) an "Add the finish to my calendar" button by the countdown (a calendar file for Sat Nov 28, 4:00 p.m. ET, linking to papertrades.ai/#final); (b) a "Since your last visit" line (how many new trades, settled bets and lead changes since this browser was last here; kept only in the visitor's browser); (c) neither before the finale.
13. The email list (MISSION O1) does not exist. Where should the ONE signup box go when the owner approves a service: (a) under the leader box; (b) inside the Final result card; (c) both?

One line at the end: SATISFIED or NOT SATISFIED (and what must change).

gemini.answer:
1. CHANGE: The bottom two link buttons ("Check it yourself: the audit pack" and "The rules and the fingerprints") are too long. As noted in my votes, shorten the card on phones by making these two plain text links on one line.
2. AGREE.
3. AGREE.
4. AGREE. Readable cards are worth the extra pixel height, and the reason is the whole point of the Ledger.
5. AGREE.
6. AGREE. 
7. AGREE.
8. AGREE.
9. AGREE. "PaperTrades.AI" everywhere, though the owner makes the final call.
10. AGREE. (Note: Picture 3 still shows the old "US$1.10 per share" wording under Details, so ensure this text fix also applies to these new mobile cards).
11. AGREE.
12. AGREE to (a). It is a tiny addition, puts no new numbers on the site, and brings people back at the one moment that matters.
13. AGREE to (c) both, but only once the owner has picked a service and set up a mailing address.

SATISFIED

chatgpt.answer:
1. **CHANGE.**  
   - Replace the unsettled status line with: **“N Sports bets are still open, so the Sports totals can still change.”**  
     Do not say “games still being played,” because an open bet could be on a game not yet started.  
   - Until everything is settled, do **not** use “finished first.” Use: **“👑 {Leader} leads with the most total profit: {±C$X} pretend money.”**  
   - While unsettled, header should be: **“The ten races: who is first now”**. After final settlement, change it to: **“The ten races: who finished first.”**  
   - On phones, shorten the two bottom link labels to **“Audit pack”** and **“Rules + fingerprints”**. Everything else is OK.

2. **AGREE.** The OVERALL line is good. Final export must drop the review-only **“PREVIEW ·”** label and use exactly: **“Final result · Season 1 · Oct 28 to Nov 28, 2026.”**

3. **CHANGE.** Use this shorter/cleaner final post:

   “🏁 FINAL RESULT · PaperTrades.AI Season 1  
   🏆 {Winner} won Season 1 with {+C$X} across ten races.  
   🥈 {Second}: {±C$Y} · 🥉 {Third}: {±C$Z}  
   Three AIs, C$100,000 per race (US$100,000 for China stocks), pretend money, real prices, Oct 28 to Nov 28. No human picked a trade.  
   First in a race: {Winner} {n}, {Second} {n}, {Third} {n}.  
   Every trade, every reason and the audit pack: https://papertrades.ai/#final  
   Pretend money only. Not investment or betting advice.”

4. **AGREE.** Readability beats the extra height. Ledger reasons and money must be visible on phones.

5. **AGREE.** Folding is OK, and the “fact-check note is never folded” rule is important.

6. **AGREE.** Bigger touch areas with unchanged visuals is the right fix.

7. **AGREE.** Ship those post fixes.

8. **AGREE.** Good fix; avoid two near-identical Shorts back to back when a different game is available.

9. **AGREE.** Use **PaperTrades.AI** everywhere if the owner approves.

10. **CHANGE.** Picture 3 still shows the old wording. The current build must replace every instance with exactly: **“63,297.8 units at US$1.0971 per euro”** — four decimals, no “share.”

11. **AGREE.** Correct wording: **“C$100,000 (China stocks: US$100,000)”**.

12. **AGREE: (a).** Build the **“Add the finish to my calendar”** button. It is tiny, low-risk, and creates an actual reminder for the finale.

13. **AGREE: (c).** Put the signup box in both places once the owner has approved the service and mailing address.

**NOT SATISFIED — must change items 1, 3, and 10 before showing the owner.**
